old_findings.note: 8 of the 12 word-wise bytes copies are gone: the encodings of getOutboundCalldata, createRetryableTicket's data and TxToL2's data are now resolved values. The 2 decoding copies of _data per function remain as word loops (new 290-293, 316-319 and the same in outboundTransferCustomRefund).
The Initializable slot now prints as stor[0xf0c57e16...6a00] instead of a multiple of 3600.

new_findings.lines: createRetryableTicket args and log TxToL2 in both functions (5 lines)
new_findings.issue: The 4-byte selector 0x2e567b36 inside the bytes argument is printed as the string literal '.V{6' because its bytes happen to be printable. The rest of the newly resolved encoding is exact (324 bytes, inner abi.encode(bytes(''), bytes('')) as 160, 128, 64, 96 and 92 zero bytes).
new_findings.rule: Print a 4-byte (or any short) constant chunk of a byte string as a string literal only when it is part of a longer run of printable text. Print a lone 4-byte word piece as hex (0x2e567b36).

improvements: outboundTransfer and outboundTransferCustomRefund lost 4 copy loops each and about 60 lines. The bridge call shows its bytes data field by field. TxToL2 is printed with named fields (_from, _to=0, _seqNum, _data). The return is Array(len=32, data=ext_call.return_data[0]) instead of 'return 32, 32, ..'. Dead escrow transferFrom buffer writes dropped (the call is named). P1 2 -> 0, P6 1 -> 0.
notes: Diff of 229 lines over 4 functions, read in full. The resolved finalizeInboundTransfer calldata was checked byte by byte against the source (selector, 4 words, offset 160, inner length 128, offsets 64/96, two zero lengths and 28 bytes of padding = Bytes(92, 0)). 'to' = 0 and the call target 0x0 are the solc immutables counterpartGateway and inbox reading as 0 (artifact, unchanged; round 1 did not record it).
summary: No regression. Most of the bytes-copy loops are replaced by exact resolved encodings, and the Initializable slot is fixed. One display wart: the finalizeInboundTransfer selector prints as the text '.V{6'.
